citrus.label: Citrus
citrus.what: Zest and juice: lemon, bergamot, grapefruit, yuzu, calamansi, dalandan.
citrus.feel: Bright, awake, clean. Fades fastest, so it usually opens a perfume.

fruity.label: Fruity
fruity.what: Flesh and juice of fruit: pear, peach, mango, berries, pineapple.

floral.label: Floral
floral.what: Flowers: rose, jasmine, sampaguita, osmanthus, tuberose, magnolia, cherry blossom, orange blossom.
floral.feel: Anywhere from fresh and dewy to creamy and heady. White flowers (tuberose, jasmine) are the richest.
floral.wear: Any time; white florals shine in warm evenings.

green.label: Green
green.what: Leaves, stems, grass, tea leaves, herbs, pine.
green.wear: Spring, daytime, when you want to feel fresh but not sweet.

gourmand.label: Gourmand
gourmand.what: Edible notes: vanilla, honey, praline, caramel, coffee, cacao, dates, milk.
gourmand.feel: Cozy, sweet, comforting. Can feel heavy in heat.

woody.label: Woody
woody.what: Sandalwood, cedar, vetiver, patchouli, guaiac, agarwood (oud).
woody.feel: Grounded, calm, dry or creamy depending on the wood.
woody.wear: All year; the backbone of most unisex scents.

amber.label: Amber (oriental)
amber.what: A warm blend of resins and balsams such as labdanum, benzoin, copal and frankincense, often with vanilla.

musk.label: Musk
musk.what: Soft 'skin' molecules (today almost always lab-made or plant-based).
musk.feel: Clean laundry, warm skin, softness. Makes other notes last.

aquatic.label: Aquatic
aquatic.what: Sea salt, sea spray, rain, coastal moss, water accords.

spicy.label: Spicy
spicy.what: Cinnamon, clove, cardamom, pepper, saffron, nutmeg, ginger, Sichuan pepper.
spicy.feel: Warm or tingly; adds energy and depth.
spicy.wear: Cooler months; small doses in summer.

_accents.incense: Smoke from burned resin or wood. In Japan and Taiwan it ties to temples and the kōdō ceremony.
_accents.oud: Agarwood: resin that forms in aquilaria trees. Can smell woody, leathery, animalic or sweet. Central to Gulf and South-East Asian scent culture.
_accents.attar: Plant material distilled into a sandalwood-oil base. Alcohol-free and very concentrated; worn as a dab.
_accents.ruh: The first, purest distillate of a single flower (ruh gulab = rose).
_accents.tea: Green, black, oolong or rock tea notes: dry, slightly bitter, calm. A signature of Chinese and Japanese houses.
_accents.copal: Sacred tree resin of Mexico and Central America: lemony, smoky, holy.
_accents.perfume oil: Fragrance in oil instead of alcohol; sits close to skin and lasts well in heat.

_pyramid: Top notes are what you smell first (minutes). Heart notes are the main character (an hour or more). Base notes are the dry-down that stays for hours.
